lead: Quote replies: select a passage in an assistant reply and a "Quote" button appears above the selection; click it and the passage is attached to the input area as a quote, so the next message replies to it. `QuoteSelection` handles the selection and the button, `Quote` is the block that shows the quote.

usage.title: Usage
usage.description: Works with the mouse or the keyboard (<kbd>Shift</kbd> + arrow keys to select, <kbd>Tab</kbd> to the button).
usage.text: Skins are plain CSS files, so switching the look never touches component code. Behaviour comes from Base UI; every visual decision lives in the skin.
usage.hint: Select some of the text above, then click the "Quote" button that appears:

quote.title: Quote
quote.description: Without `onRemove` (as in sent messages) it is a read-only quote block.
quote.text: Skins are plain CSS files, so switching the look never touches component code. Behaviour comes from Base UI; every visual decision lives in the skin and nothing else needs to change when the look changes.
